blocks.source: Canto XI
blocks.translation: Canto XI

blocks.source: In su l’estremità d’un’alta ripa
blocks.translation: Upon the margin of a lofty bank

blocks.source: che facevan gran pietre rotte in cerchio,
blocks.translation: Which great rocks broken in a circle made,

blocks.source: venimmo sopra più crudele stipa;
blocks.translation: We came upon a still more cruel throng;

blocks.source: e quivi, per l’orribile soperchio
blocks.translation: And there, by reason of the horrible

blocks.source: del puzzo che ’l profondo abisso gitta,
blocks.translation: Excess of stench the deep abyss throws out,

blocks.source: ci raccostammo, in dietro, ad un coperchio
blocks.translation: We drew ourselves aside behind the cover

blocks.source: d’un grand’ avello, ov’ io vidi una scritta
blocks.translation: Of a great tomb, whereon I saw a writing,

blocks.source: che dicea: ‘Anastasio papa guardo,
blocks.translation: Which said: “Pope Anastasius I hold,

blocks.source: lo qual trasse Fotin de la via dritta’.
blocks.translation: Whom out of the right way Photinus drew.”

blocks.source: «Lo nostro scender conviene esser tardo,
blocks.translation: “Slow it behoveth our descent to be,

blocks.source: sì che s’ausi un poco in prima il senso
blocks.translation: So that the sense be first a little used

blocks.source: al tristo fiato; e poi no i fia riguardo».
blocks.translation: To the sad blast, and then we shall not heed it.”

blocks.source: Così ’l maestro; e io «Alcun compenso»,
blocks.translation: The Master thus; and unto him I said,

blocks.source: dissi lui, «trova che ’l tempo non passi
blocks.translation: “Some compensation find, that the time pass not

blocks.source: perduto». Ed elli: «Vedi ch’a ciò penso».
blocks.translation: Idly;” and he: “Thou seest I think of that.

blocks.source: «Figliuol mio, dentro da cotesti sassi»,
blocks.translation: My son, upon the inside of these rocks,”

blocks.source: cominciò poi a dir, «son tre cerchietti
blocks.translation: Began he then to say, “are three small circles,

blocks.source: di grado in grado, come que’ che lassi.
blocks.translation: From grade to grade, like those which thou art leaving.

blocks.source: Tutti son pien di spirti maladetti;
blocks.translation: They all are full of spirits maledict;

blocks.source: ma perché poi ti basti pur la vista,
blocks.translation: But that hereafter sight alone suffice thee,

blocks.source: intendi come e perché son costretti.
blocks.translation: Hear how and wherefore they are in constraint.

blocks.source: D’ogne malizia, ch’odio in cielo acquista,
blocks.translation: Of every malice that wins hate in Heaven,

blocks.source: ingiuria è ’l fine, ed ogne fin cotale
blocks.translation: Injury is the end; and all such end

blocks.source: o con forza o con frode altrui contrista.
blocks.translation: Either by force or fraud afflicteth others.

blocks.source: Ma perché frode è de l’uom proprio male,
blocks.translation: But because fraud is man’s peculiar vice,

blocks.source: più spiace a Dio; e però stan di sotto
blocks.translation: More it displeases God; and so stand lowest

blocks.source: li frodolenti, e più dolor li assale.
blocks.translation: The fraudulent, and greater dole assails them.

blocks.source: Di vïolenti il primo cerchio è tutto;
blocks.translation: All the first circle of the Violent is;

blocks.source: ma perché si fa forza a tre persone,
blocks.translation: But since force may be used against three persons,

blocks.source: in tre gironi è distinto e costrutto.
blocks.translation: In three rounds ’tis divided and constructed.

blocks.source: A Dio, a sé, al prossimo si pòne
blocks.translation: To God, to ourselves, and to our neighbour can we

blocks.source: far forza, dico in loro e in lor cose,
blocks.translation: Use force; I say on them and on their things,

blocks.source: come udirai con aperta ragione.
blocks.translation: As thou shalt hear with reason manifest.

blocks.source: Morte per forza e ferute dogliose
blocks.translation: A death by violence, and painful wounds,

blocks.source: nel prossimo si danno, e nel suo avere
blocks.translation: Are to our neighbour given; and in his substance

blocks.source: ruine, incendi e tollette dannose;
blocks.translation: Ruin, and arson, and injurious levies;

blocks.source: onde omicide e ciascun che mal fiere,
blocks.translation: Whence homicides, and he who smites unjustly,

blocks.source: guastatori e predon, tutti tormenta
blocks.translation: Marauders, and freebooters, the first round

blocks.source: lo giron primo per diverse schiere.
blocks.translation: Tormenteth all in companies diverse.

blocks.source: Puote omo avere in sé man vïolenta
blocks.translation: Man may lay violent hands upon himself

blocks.source: e ne’ suoi beni; e però nel secondo
blocks.translation: And his own goods; and therefore in the second

blocks.source: giron convien che sanza pro si penta
blocks.translation: Round must perforce without avail repent

blocks.source: qualunque priva sé del vostro mondo,
blocks.translation: Whoever of your world deprives himself,

blocks.source: biscazza e fonde la sua facultade,
blocks.translation: Who games, and dissipates his property,

blocks.source: e piange là dov’ esser de’ giocondo.
blocks.translation: And weepeth there, where he should jocund be.

blocks.source: Puossi far forza ne la deïtade,
blocks.translation: Violence can be done the Deity,

blocks.source: col cor negando e bestemmiando quella,
blocks.translation: In heart denying and blaspheming Him,

blocks.source: e spregiando natura e sua bontade;
blocks.translation: And by disdaining Nature and her bounty.

blocks.source: e però lo minor giron suggella
blocks.translation: And for this reason doth the smallest round

blocks.source: del segno suo e Soddoma e Caorsa
blocks.translation: Seal with its signet Sodom and Cahors,

blocks.source: e chi, spregiando Dio col cor, favella.
blocks.translation: And who, disdaining God, speaks from the heart.

blocks.source: La frode, ond’ ogne coscïenza è morsa,
blocks.translation: Fraud, wherewithal is every conscience stung,

blocks.source: può l’omo usare in colui che ’n lui fida
blocks.translation: A man may practise upon him who trusts,

blocks.source: e in quel che fidanza non imborsa.
blocks.translation: And him who doth no confidence imburse.

blocks.source: Questo modo di retro par ch’incida
blocks.translation: This latter mode, it would appear, dissevers

blocks.source: pur lo vinco d’amor che fa natura;
blocks.translation: Only the bond of love which Nature makes;

blocks.source: onde nel cerchio secondo s’annida
blocks.translation: Wherefore within the second circle nestle

blocks.source: ipocresia, lusinghe e chi affattura,
blocks.translation: Hypocrisy, flattery, and who deals in magic,

blocks.source: falsità, ladroneccio e simonia,
blocks.translation: Falsification, theft, and simony,

blocks.source: ruffian, baratti e simile lordura.
blocks.translation: Panders, and barrators, and the like filth.

blocks.source: Per l’altro modo quell’ amor s’oblia
blocks.translation: By the other mode, forgotten is that love

blocks.source: che fa natura, e quel ch’è poi aggiunto,
blocks.translation: Which Nature makes, and what is after added,

blocks.source: di che la fede spezïal si cria;
blocks.translation: From which there is a special faith engendered.

blocks.source: onde nel cerchio minore, ov’ è ’l punto
blocks.translation: Hence in the smallest circle, where the point is

blocks.source: de l’universo in su che Dite siede,
blocks.translation: Of the Universe, upon which Dis is seated,

blocks.source: qualunque trade in etterno è consunto».
blocks.translation: Whoe’er betrays for ever is consumed.”

blocks.source: E io: «Maestro, assai chiara procede
blocks.translation: And I: “My Master, clear enough proceeds

blocks.source: la tua ragione, e assai ben distingue
blocks.translation: Thy reasoning, and full well distinguishes

blocks.source: questo baràtro e ’l popol ch’e’ possiede.
blocks.translation: This cavern and the people who possess it.

blocks.source: Ma dimmi: quei de la palude pingue,
blocks.translation: But tell me, those within the fat lagoon,

blocks.source: che mena il vento, e che batte la pioggia,
blocks.translation: Whom the wind drives, and whom the rain doth beat,

blocks.source: e che s’incontran con sì aspre lingue,
blocks.translation: And who encounter with such bitter tongues,

blocks.source: perché non dentro da la città roggia
blocks.translation: Wherefore are they inside of the red city

blocks.source: sono ei puniti, se Dio li ha in ira?
blocks.translation: Not punished, if God has them in his wrath,

blocks.source: e se non li ha, perché sono a tal foggia?».
blocks.translation: And if he has not, wherefore in such fashion?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me «Perché tanto delira»,
blocks.translation: And unto me he said: “Why wanders so

blocks.source: disse, «lo ’ngegno tuo da quel che sòle?
blocks.translation: Thine intellect from that which it is wont?

blocks.source: o ver la mente dove altrove mira?
blocks.translation: Or, sooth, thy mind where is it elsewhere looking?

blocks.source: Non ti rimembra di quelle parole
blocks.translation: Hast thou no recollection of those words

blocks.source: con le quai la tua Etica pertratta
blocks.translation: With which thine Ethics thoroughly discusses

blocks.source: le tre disposizion che ’l ciel non vole,
blocks.translation: The dispositions three, that Heaven abides not,—

blocks.source: incontenenza, malizia e la matta
blocks.translation: Incontinence, and Malice, and insane

blocks.source: bestialitade? e come incontenenza
blocks.translation: Bestiality? and how Incontinence

blocks.source: men Dio offende e men biasimo accatta?
blocks.translation: Less God offendeth, and less blame attracts?

blocks.source: Se tu riguardi ben questa sentenza,
blocks.translation: If thou regardest this conclusion well,

blocks.source: e rechiti a la mente chi son quelli
blocks.translation: And to thy mind recallest who they are

blocks.source: che sù di fuor sostegnon penitenza,
blocks.translation: That up outside are undergoing penance,

blocks.source: tu vedrai ben perché da questi felli
blocks.translation: Clearly wilt thou perceive why from these felons

blocks.source: sien dipartiti, e perché men crucciata
blocks.translation: They separated are, and why less wroth

blocks.source: la divina vendetta li martelli».
blocks.translation: Justice divine doth smite them with its hammer.”

blocks.source: «O sol che sani ogne vista turbata,
blocks.translation: “O Sun, that healest all distempered vision,

blocks.source: tu mi contenti sì quando tu solvi,
blocks.translation: Thou dost content me so, when thou resolvest,

blocks.source: che, non men che saver, dubbiar m’aggrata.
blocks.translation: That doubting pleases me no less than knowing!

blocks.source: Ancora in dietro un poco ti rivolvi»,
blocks.translation: Once more a little backward turn thee,” said I,

blocks.source: diss’ io, «là dove di’ ch’usura offende
blocks.translation: “There where thou sayest that usury offends

blocks.source: la divina bontade, e ’l groppo solvi».
blocks.translation: Goodness divine, and disengage the knot.”

blocks.source: «Filosofia», mi disse, «a chi la ’ntende,
blocks.translation: “Philosophy,” he said, “to him who heeds it,

blocks.source: nota, non pure in una sola parte,
blocks.translation: Noteth, not only in one place alone,

blocks.source: come natura lo suo corso prende
blocks.translation: After what manner Nature takes her course

blocks.source: dal divino ’ntelletto e da sua arte;
blocks.translation: From Intellect Divine, and from its art;

blocks.source: e se tu ben la tua Fisica note,
blocks.translation: And if thy Physics carefully thou notest,

blocks.source: tu troverai, non dopo molte carte,
blocks.translation: After not many pages shalt thou find,

blocks.source: che l’arte vostra quella, quanto pote,
blocks.translation: That this your art as far as possible

blocks.source: segue, come ’l maestro fa ’l discente;
blocks.translation: Follows, as the disciple doth the master;

blocks.source: sì che vostr’ arte a Dio quasi è nepote.
blocks.translation: So that your art is, as it were, God’s grandchild.

blocks.source: Da queste due, se tu ti rechi a mente
blocks.translation: From these two, if thou bringest to thy mind

blocks.source: lo Genesì dal principio, convene
blocks.translation: Genesis at the beginning, it behoves

blocks.source: prender sua vita e avanzar la gente;
blocks.translation: Mankind to gain their life and to advance;

blocks.source: e perché l’usuriere altra via tene,
blocks.translation: And since the usurer takes another way,

blocks.source: per sé natura e per la sua seguace
blocks.translation: Nature herself and in her follower

blocks.source: dispregia, poi ch’in altro pon la spene.
blocks.translation: Disdains he, for elsewhere he puts his hope.

blocks.source: Ma seguimi oramai che ’l gir mi piace;
blocks.translation: But follow, now, as I would fain go on,

blocks.source: ché i Pesci guizzan su per l’orizzonta,
blocks.translation: For quivering are the Fishes on the horizon,

blocks.source: e ’l Carro tutto sovra ’l Coro giace,
blocks.translation: And the Wain wholly over Caurus lies,

blocks.source: e ’l balzo via là oltra si dismonta».
blocks.translation: And far beyond there we descend the crag.”
